economic_model.equation: A_ij=Z_ij/x_j; Δx=(I−A)^−1Δy; ΔVA_i=(VA_i/x_i)Δx_i; source balance residuals held fixed.
scenario_assumptions: Conditional fixed-coefficient Leontief demand accounting; not a causal forecast or a supply-shortage model.
The scenario changes global net final demand for the selected producing country-industry’s output, not its capacity or intermediate sales.
Technical input coefficients, value-added/output coefficients, prices, trade structure and exchange rates are held fixed.
No substitution, capacity limits, inventories adjustment behavior, price response or household distribution is modeled.
Only ICIO value added is propagated. National employee-pay/tax/surplus components are displayed as baseline source values and not blindly allocated to model changes.
All 4,050 source industry-country nodes participate. Published balance residuals are retained and held fixed; their causes are not inferred or forced away.
limitations: These are harmonized monetary country-industry accounts, not physical shipments, bank transfers or named-company payments.
Gross output, value added, employee compensation, production taxes, depreciation and net operating surplus are different measures. Sector operating surplus is not a named company’s net profit.
Current USD values reflect each year’s prices and exchange rates; this view makes no inflation or purchasing-power adjustment.
The regular global matrix has 80 economies plus a rest-of-world account and 50 industries; broad sectors do not identify a particular commodity, factory or household.
ICIO and national IOT components are separate harmonized sources. Their levels can differ; component amounts are displayed with their own source, not forced to equal ICIO value added.
No employment, household distribution, environmental burden or corporate-parent attribution is inferred from these accounts.
The 2025 edition can contain extrapolated or balanced estimates. Source accounts do not supply statistical confidence intervals for every cell.

economic_model.money_vs_resource_warning: Monetary accounts are not physical tonnes/flows, individual incomes, owner receipts or welfare; native commodity classes require explicit documented industry mappings before joining.

research_comparability_rules: Choose a question and estimand before pooling rows.
Align reporting years, geographic populations and source boundaries explicitly.
Separate physical quantities, monetary accounts, prices, exposure and welfare; joins do not establish identical concepts.
Use documented unit conversions only; no automatic PPP/deflation/per-capita transform.
Preserve estimates, publisher imputations and unavailable values as source facts.
Record actual modeling/transformations and uncertainty separately from published source cells.
Mixed-year latest-available maps are descriptive inventories, not same-year panels.
Correlation/regression/scenarios do not automatically identify causal economic-model superiority.
